comments.name: Ana Rodrigues
comments.text: Fomm ir-Riħ blew my mind! We were the only people there on a Tuesday afternoon. The cliffs are dramatic and the sea colour is unreal. Great tip Tiago.

comments.name: James Thornton
comments.text: Mtaħleb at sunset — yes! We stumbled on a tiny bar there and the owner told us stories for hours over wine. Malta's people are as beautiful as the scenery.
